Village blacksmith Kunjunni and orphaned Maya build a loving marriage in their rural community. However, problems arise when a local truck driver makes inappropriate advances toward Maya.
Balakrishnan, who is in desperate need of a heart transplant, receives the heart of Aby. However, things take an unexpected turn when he starts seeing Aby's ghost.
Balan, a doctor, is happily married to Shanthi. However, his life changes after he meets his former girlfriend, admitted in his hospital, who has a faint chance of survival.
When Unnimol, a young girl child, faces dismissal from all her relatives and community, Lord Ayyappan takes the form of a school student to help her overcome obstacles.
Retirees Omanakuttan Pilla, Cherian Thomas and Mahendran Thambi decide to set up a drama troupe in order to stay active. However, they endure several hurdles and incidents in the process.
Vishnu gets acquainted with Raghu during a trip and learns that he is rich and is returning home after 16 years. Then, Vishnu pushes Raghu into a ravine and goes to his house pretending to be him.
Ramakrishnan's friend Sagar helps him deal with Priyadarshini, who refuses to let him take charge of decisions at his new post. But Priyadarshini shocks them when she frames the duo for rape.
